learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to use typical services of operating systems in their C programs.

They will understand concepts from the theory and practice of operating systems: memory management, process and thread synchronization, input/output devices and file systems, user maintenance, and internal principles of modern operating systems.
They will be able to apply the knowledge in operating systems administration and application development.

syllabus_topics: organization of hard drives and ssd
assessment_rules: To qualify for a final credit, students need to correctly answer 70% of quiz questions, and solve 70% of practical tasks. The grade is calculated proportionally to the score achieved. Assessment is 100% during the semester, with the possibility of an exam in case of a lack of points.
bibliography: Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau, Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau and Peter Reiher: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces, Arpaci-Dusseau Books, August, 2018.
Andrew S. Tanenbaum and Herbert Bos: Modern Operating Systems, Fourth Edition, Pearson, 2014.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
